Zoe: Quick vote: which office mascot should get a tiny desk plaque? :lion: :penguin: :taco:
Matt: Taco obviously. It represents snack diplomacy. :taco:
Nora: Penguin. Low-key, judgmental, but supportive. :penguin:
Jenna: Lion. Fierce coffee protector. :lion_face:
OpsBot: Poll created: :ballot_box: 3412345670/polls/1 — react with :one: for Taco, :two: for Penguin, :three: for Lion.
Matt: Also can we get a tiny hat for the winner? Micro merch idea.
Zoe: yes tiny hats. Vote = funding approved.
Nora: Shoutout to @Jenna for fixing the plant watering schedule last week. It stopped plotting to take over the snack shelf. :seedling: :raised_hands:
Jenna: Haha glad the ficus is no longer conspiring. Thank you for the kudos!
Matt: Two quick one-liners to brighten your afternoon: "Coffee: because adulting is hard." and "If anyone needs me, I will be downstairs negotiating with the espresso machine." :coffee:
Zoe: "Snack drawer: where dreams and mystery crumbs collide."
OpsBot: Friendly reminder: kitchen leftovers labeled? If unlabeled for 72 hours, they become public property. :warning:
Nora: Noted. I labeled my leftover lasagna "Nora - Do not steal (but you can ask)"
Jenna: Important constitutional amendment: any mascot plaque ceremony requires commemorative cupcakes.
Matt: Cupcakes = unanimous yes.
Zoe: Final poll extension: react to OpsBot poll. We close at 5pm. May the best tiny hat win. :top_hat:
